capabilities: Calculate four-pillar charts from birth year, date, time, and gender
Correct birth times to true solar time using a 400+ city coordinate database
Convert between Gregorian and lunar calendar dates
Analyze ten gods, luck pillars, yearly/monthly cycles, and hidden stems
Save charts as Markdown case files with YAML frontmatter and load them by chart code
extras: README is written almost entirely in Chinese with an English subtitle; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; it supports installation via BRAT and includes a donation link. Chart rendering uses Shadow DOM isolation to avoid theme style interference.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to compute or render Four Pillars (Bazi) charts, so practitioners must leave the vault or paste static results.

relations.evidence: 本插件基于 paipan.js 引擎，算法透明可追溯

summary: Bazi (Four Pillars) calculator that generates Chinese astrology charts from birth data in a sidebar, a floating left panel, or embedded code blocks.
